description: Fischer–Tropsch synthesis (FT) produces hydrocarbon fuels from syngas (CO + H₂). Operating conditions include high pressures and temperatures, with CO conversion to liquid hydrocarbons.
summary: Inputs include CO₂, H₂O, CH₄, N₂. Outputs FT fuels, CO, H₂O, and minor byproducts. CAPEX ranges from €28.4–€42.5 M for RWGS unit and €100.1–€195.8 M for FT synthesis. OPEX not explicitly stated but included in MSP calculations. Efficiency is ~70% for syngas production and ~60% for FT synthesis. TRL 8, lifetime 25 years, reference capacity 116.4 kt_FT-fuel/y.
